title: find_people input
description: Finds people by name among the people the product knows (O05 Principal References), for a picker: a successor, an owner, the business owner of a request. Every word given must start a word of the name. Users only unless principalKinds says otherwise. Erased people are never found. No leave date is returned. Writes nothing.

text.description: Two or more letters of the name, such as "pri pa" for Priya Patel.

principalKinds.description: The kinds to find. Default: user.

activeOnly.description: True leaves out people the last owner check found disabled or deleted.
